gtnhextranerf.research.metal_transmutati.english: By combining metal nuggets with aspects, you can create tiny piles of the corresponding metal dust.
gtnhextranerf.research.metal_transmutati.chinese: 将金属粒与要素结合，可以制成相应金属的小撮粉末。

gtnhextranerf.consent.scope.english: Choose one mode or disable reporting. The choice applies to this world and can be changed with /extranerftelemetry and /extranerfteam.
gtnhextranerf.consent.scope.chinese: 选择一种上报方式，或关闭上报。此选择适用于当前世界，可通过 /extranerftelemetry 和 /extranerfteam 随时更改。

gtnhextranerf.consent.minimal.english: Basic statistics contribute to anonymous, aggregated stats on our website. Reports include a random server-run ID, player count, progression tier, world type and optional build proof, but no player names or UUIDs.
gtnhextranerf.consent.minimal.chinese: 基础统计会用于网站上的匿名汇总数据。上报内容包括本次服务器运行的随机标识、玩家人数、进度等级、世界类型，以及可选的构建验证信息；不包含玩家名称或 UUID。

gtnhextranerf.consent.team.english: Team tracking can show your team publicly. Reports include a team ID, leader and online players' names and UUIDs, progression tier, world type and optional build proof.
gtnhextranerf.consent.team.chinese: 队伍追踪可能在网站上公开展示你的队伍。上报内容包括队伍标识、队长及在线玩家的名称和 UUID、进度等级、世界类型，以及可选的构建验证信息。

tile.gtnhextranerf.iron_bath_casing.1.na.chinese: 锻铁强化耐火机械方块

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tap.description.english: Draws from its height band, prioritizing slag
gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tap.description.chinese: 从所在高度层排出液体，优先排渣

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tap.screwdriver.english: Screwdriver: discharge amount. Sneak: redstone mode
gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tap.screwdriver.chinese: 螺丝刀：排出量；潜行：红石模式

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.capacity_error.english: The contents exceed this coil tier's capacity
gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.capacity_error.chinese: 炉内物料超过当前线圈等级的容量上限

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.buffered_inputs.english: Use buffered item and fluid input hatches
gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.buffered_inputs.chinese: 请使用缓冲输入总线和输入仓

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.gui.metal_capaci.chinese: 金属容量上限（含待熔物料）：%s mB

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tap.mode.descrip.english: Discharge once when the redstone signal turns on
gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tap.mode.descrip.chinese: 红石信号开启时排出一次

variants.Start one batch when the redstone signal: 红石信号开启时开始一整批

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tap.mode.descrip.english: Discharge every tick while redstone is on
gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tap.mode.descrip.chinese: 有红石信号时每刻排出

variants.Pour while redstone is on: 有红石信号时持续浇铸

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tap.mode.cycle.english: Left click: next mode. Right click: previous mode
gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tap.mode.cycle.chinese: 左键：下一模式；右键：上一模式

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.gui.charge_help.english: Matching items with the same progress share a melting group and divide the available heating power. Queued metal reserves tank space. Carbon enters the bath directly
gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.gui.charge_help.chinese: 数据与进度相同的物品归为一组，分摊可用加热功率。待熔金属预占浴槽空间；碳直接进入浴槽

gtnhextranerf.nei.iron_bath.ratio.chinese: R（%%）= 碳单位数 /（铁量 mB / 144）

gtnhextranerf.nei.iron_bath.oxygen.english: Optional Oxygen trim: 32 mB removes 1 C
gtnhextranerf.nei.iron_bath.oxygen.chinese: 可选氧气脱碳：32 mB 氧气去除 1 单位碳

gtnhextranerf.nei.iron_bath.flux.english: 1 Calcite binds up to 20 impurity units
gtnhextranerf.nei.iron_bath.flux.chinese: 1 份方解石最多结合 20 单位杂质

gtnhextranerf.nei.iron_bath.calcite_cons.chinese: 此物料平衡消耗 %s 份方解石粉

gtnhextranerf.nei.iron_bath.calcite_rese.english: Load %s whole dust. Unused flux capacity remains in the bath
gtnhextranerf.nei.iron_bath.calcite_rese.chinese: 投入 %s 份完整粉末；未用完的助熔容量保留在浴槽中

gtnhextranerf.nei.iron_bath.carbon.chinese: 每份提供：%s 单位碳、%s 单位杂质

gtnhextranerf.nei.iron_bath.heated.english: Carbon enters the bath directly without melting
gtnhextranerf.nei.iron_bath.heated.chinese: 碳直接进入浴槽，无须熔化

gtnhextranerf.nei.iron_bath.iron.english: 1 Iron ingot or dust supplies 144 mB
gtnhextranerf.nei.iron_bath.iron.chinese: 1 份铁锭或铁粉提供 144 mB 铁

gtnhextranerf.nei.iron_bath.slag.english: 32 mB Slag per bound impurity unit
gtnhextranerf.nei.iron_bath.slag.chinese: 每结合 1 单位杂质产生 32 mB 炉渣

gtnhextranerf.nei.iron_bath.tap_control.english: Tap the liquid at the selected carbon range
gtnhextranerf.nei.iron_bath.tap_control.chinese: 在所选碳含量区间排出液体

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.measurement.desc.english: Read-only exact measurements from a formed Iron Bath
gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.measurement.desc.chinese: 只读获取已成形铁浴的精确测量值

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.measurement.conn.english: Optional side platform hatch. Connect an OpenComputers Adapter and call read()
gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.measurement.conn.chinese: 侧平台可选仓位；连接 OpenComputers 适配器并调用 read()

variants.Mount on the chimney, connect an OpenCom: 安装在烟囱上，连接 OpenComputers 适配器并调用 read()

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.energy_hatches.english: Use between one and eight energy hatches
gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.energy_hatches.chinese: 请使用 1 至 8 个能源仓

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.info.0.english: Electrically heats a persistent iron and carbon bath
gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.info.0.chinese: 使用电力加热可持久保存的铁碳浴槽

variants.Adjust the carbon content of molten iron: 调整熔融铁的碳含量，制成不同合金

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.info.1.english: Accepts ingots, dusts, carbon additives, Calcite and Oxygen
gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.info.1.chinese: 接受锭、粉、碳添加剂、方解石和氧气

variants.Use Calcite to bind impurities and oxyge: 用方解石结合杂质，用氧气降低碳含量

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.info.2.english: Tapping height selects molten metal, slag or empty space
gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.info.2.chinese: 浇铸仓高度决定抽取熔融金属、炉渣或空层

variants.Metal settles below slag, and tap height: 金属沉在炉渣下方；浇铸高度决定可流出的物质

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.info.3.english: Cupronickel coils provide 512 ingots of bath capacity
gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.info.3.chinese: 白铜线圈提供 512 锭的浴槽容量

variants.More amps at the same voltage melt more: 同电压增加安培数，可以并行熔化更多物品

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.info.4.chinese: 每升一级线圈，浴槽容量翻倍

variants.Higher voltage overclocks the bath, and: 更高电压使铁浴超频，更好线圈改善熔化能力

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.info.5.english: Queued metal reserves tank space and shares the available heating power
gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.info.5.chinese: 待熔金属预占浴槽空间，并共享可用加热功率

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.info.6.english: Extra amperage gives proportional throughput at the same EU per ingot
gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.info.6.chinese: 增加电流会按比例提高产能，每锭耗电不变

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.info.7.english: Higher voltage applies native EBF overclocks and coil heat bonuses
gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.info.7.chinese: 更高电压采用原生工业高炉超频及线圈温度加成

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.info.8.english: Calcite reserve: 180 binding units, plus 160 per coil upgrade
gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.info.8.chinese: 方解石储备为 180 结合单位，每升一级线圈增加 160

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.info.9.english: Refractory chimney with exposed coils and a raised feed conveyor
gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.info.9.chinese: 带外露线圈与高架进料输送带的耐火烟囱

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.info.10.english: Start with base refractory casings and Cupronickel coils
gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.info.10.chinese: 从基础耐火机械方块和白铜线圈起步

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.info.11.english: Optional LuV Measurement Hatch: read-only OpenComputers telemetry
gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.info.11.chinese: 可选 LuV 测量仓：OpenComputers 只读测量

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.info.12.english: Wrought Iron reinforcement improves insulation after the first bath
gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.info.12.chinese: 首次铁浴生产后可用锻铁强化，提高隔热性能

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.structur.english: Side platform beside the feed conveyor
gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.structur.chinese: 进料输送带旁的侧平台

variants.1 or more beside the coils, with all fiv: 线圈旁至少 1 个；NEI 展示全部五种安装高度

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.measurement_hatc.english: Use at most one Bath Measurement Hatch
gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.measurement_hatc.chinese: 最多安装 1 个铁浴测量仓

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.structur.english: Chimney base and the five exposed coil layers
gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.structur.chinese: 烟囱底座和五层外露线圈

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.structur.english: Any Steel Machine Casing on the controller platform
gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.structur.chinese: 控制器平台上的任意钢机械方块位置

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.structur.english: Requires 1+ Input Buses, 1+ Fluid Input Hatches and exactly 1 Maintenance Hatch
gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.structur.chinese: 需要至少 1 个输入总线、至少 1 个流体输入仓，且恰好 1 个维护仓

gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.structur.english: Optional (LuV) in place of any refractory casing on the chimney
gtnhextranerf.iron_bath.tooltip.structur.chinese: 可选（LuV）：替换烟囱上的任意耐火外壳
